title: QuestionResponse
description: Response envelope returned by /api.php containing the question batch.

response_code.description: Outcome code: 0 success, 1 no results, 2 invalid parameter, 3 token not found, 4 token empty, 5 rate limit exceeded.

response_message.description: Human-readable description of the response code (optional).

results.description: Array of trivia questions matching the request parameters.
